name: Fiserv CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: Fiserv, Inc. provides financial services technology through Merchant and Financial segments. The Merchant segment supplies merchant acquiring, digital commerce and mobile payments, along with stored-value, pay-by-bank, security and fraud protection solutions for businesses of every size. The Financial segment handles loan and deposit account processing, digital payments and card transactions for banks and other financial institutions as well as corporate and public sector clients.
